name: Aldermoor Court
description: Six-storey residential building with 48 apartments above a one-level underground car park (62 spaces) on a reinforced concrete raft. In-situ concrete frame, brick slip rainscreen facade and aluminium windows.

name: Kestrel Lane Townhouses
description: Eight two-storey, three-bedroom timber-frame townhouses with private gardens, MVHR and individual air source heat pumps.

name: Harbour Yard Offices
description: Four-storey office building of approximately 5,200 m² with ground floor retail, currently at planning and design stage.
